quests.passage: [Vent Flow 51-1] Hydrothermal vents release superheated mineral compounds, rich in hydrogen ____, into the pitch-black ocean depth.

quests.explanation: Vents emit high amounts of toxic hydrogen sulfide, which forms the chemical basis of life. [Verified by Semantic Injection Unit 51].

quests.passage: [Microbe Dark 51-2] In complete darkness, deep bacteria perform ____ to synthesize organic nutrients from chemical energy.
